privatePage.description: Link text for the private page

statusConnected.message: ✓ Connected — your likes arrive on their own

statusNoConfirm.message: No confirmation from the server yet.

openPrivateConnect.message: Copy your code below and send /par to the bot.

parHint.message: Send /par followed by this code to the bot. No codes to memorize after that.

errSyncOff.message: sync is off: nothing is sent

privacyShort.message: Everything EchoLike records stays in this browser until you connect an inbox. You can export a copy at any time.

syncLabel.message: Sync to my EchoLike inbox (encrypted, off by default)

privacyLong.message: Everything EchoLike records (likes, bookmarks, written and voice notes) is stored in this browser's own extension storage. With sync off, the extension makes no network requests of its own. You can export a copy at any time, and delete it by removing the extension.

syncLong.message: If you turn sync on, each event is encrypted in this browser (AES-256-GCM) with a key only this browser and your paired inbox hold, then relayed through ntfy.sh to the EchoLike inbox you pair with. The relay only sees unreadable text.

exportHint.message: The export contains your items only, never your sync key.

imported.message: Imported $1 new items (of $2 in the file).

privacySyncOn.message: Saved in this browser, and sync is ON: each event is also sent encrypted to your paired EchoLike inbox.

transportLong.message: Direct posts each event to your own inbox (instant confirmation, no codes). Legacy uses the ntfy + Telegram-bot pipe. Both sends through both (deduped server-side).

tokenSaved.message: Saved — leave blank to keep it.

errNoToken.message: No device token yet — open Inbox settings and paste it.

errBadToken.message: Inbox rejected the token (401). Check the device token.

errBadInboxUrl.message: Inbox URL must start with https://

directActive.message: Direct inbox active — confirmations arrive instantly.

pairHint.message: Your device token is printed by YOUR inbox — server.py shows it on first start. The bot below is only for the legacy pipe.
pairHint.description: token comes from the user's own server

presetLocal.description: one-tap preset filling the local server URL

presetHint.message: Run python3 server.py on your computer, then Save. From your phone use this computer's IP (Tailscale/LAN), not 127.0.0.1.
presetHint.description: how the local server URL works

permDenied.message: Permission denied — direct sync waits until you allow it.

ownServerTitle.message: No inbox yet? Run your own in 1 minute:

ownServerSteps.message: 1. Download server.py. 2. Run: python3 server.py. 3. Paste the URL and token it prints below, then Save.

errIsVault.message: That is the secrets vault (:8904), not the inbox. Use port 8911 with http, not https.
errIsVault.description: user pointed the inbox at the vault

errHttpsIp.message: https to a bare IP almost never works — home servers use http://. Change https:// to http://.

errCantReach.message: No answer. Check: http (not https), port 8911, server.py running, same VPN/wifi as the server. Open the URL in the browser: if /api/health loads, it is the extension permission — Save again and Allow.

simpleSub.message: Paste the address of your inbox and press Connect — the rest is automatic.

noInboxHint.message: no inbox yet? run server.py on your computer, then paste its address here.

tokenTitle.message: Device token (only if your server gave you one)

tokenHint.message: Servers that accept claims give you a token automatically. Paste one here only for a hosted inbox that handed it to you.

transportLongShort.message: Direct posts to your inbox. Legacy is the old ntfy pipe. Both sends through both.

errClaimClosed.message: This server does not accept automatic claims: paste its token in Advanced.

errDeviceLimit.message: This server already has all the devices it accepts.

errTooManyClaims.message: Too many attempts from this network. Try again in an hour.

errClaim.message: The server did not give a token.

errOldServer.message: That inbox is an older version: update it or use a newer server.
